Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 38  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly identified the "Family Fun Membership" cost of $300 as the relevant annual pass for the family, without verifying if this membership was the most cost-effective option. The conversation revealed multiple membership options, such as the "Military Membership" for $250, which could have been applicable to the family if they qualified. WebSurfer failed to explore or confirm eligibility for these alternative, potentially cheaper options, leading to an inaccurate calculation of savings.
